clauses.text: Nothing is sent to Google before you say yes on the card

steps.do: Settings, Models: press g (Google Gemini, experimental). Read the consent card and answer No first.
steps.expect: The card says what goes to Google. Nothing is sent while you answer No.

clauses.text: A spoken sentence comes back as text through Gemini

steps.do: With your key set by you (never in chat) and Gemini chosen, use DICTATE and speak one sentence.
steps.expect: The spoken sentence appears as text.
